source.name: Trusts and estates statistics (IR6)
source.assumptions: Most recent published tax year is 2024 (year ended 31 March 2024) - this predates the 39% trustee tax rate, which only took effect 1 April 2024, so it's a pre-rate-change base being taxed at post-change rates in this simulator. No per-band distribution is published; this is an aggregate figure only. See TODO.md.
